title: DIG Connector Manifest
description: Manifest for a data source / sink connector. Same general shape as step manifests but simpler — connectors don't run inside the DAG, they read/write at the dataset and output boundaries.

kind.description: Source = reads data; sink = writes data; both = supports both directions.

uriSchemes.description: URI schemes this connector handles, e.g. ['file'] or ['file','s3'].

fileExtensions.description: File extensions this connector recognizes when probing a source. Lowercase, no leading dot, e.g. ['csv','tsv'].

options.description: Per-connector option spec map. Same shape as step paramSpec.

metadata.description: Free-form connector/author metadata not interpreted by DIG core.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension fields. Vendors / enterprise / forks attach their own data under a top-level namespace key so future first-party fields never collide.
